results.title: Mysterious Bird
results.overview: Follows Grammy-winning guitarist Gabriela Quintero as she creates her debut solo album, charting a path beyond her global success with Rodrigo y Gabriela.

results.title: Das dunkle Vermächtnis
results.overview: Hamburg-based photographer Kim Wenrich returns to her hometown of Nebra to give a statement to the police. Her father, Paul, is suspected of murder: he allegedly stabbed his former best friend, Arko Haumann, during an argument. Decades earlier, the two men had discovered the Bronze Age Nebra Sky Disc, one of the most significant archaeological finds of the 20th century. Detective Ritter is counting on Kim’s help to solve this strange case. He wants to know why that sensational discovery turned the treasure hunters into such bitter enemies. Convinced of her father’s innocence, Kim dismisses the idea the disc carries a deadly curse, a superstition feared by some in the small town. Although she initially intends to return to Hamburg as soon as possible, she begins to pursue the truth after finding a mysterious letter from her father and being reminded by her childhood friend Jonny of a secret from their youth. In doing so, she embarks on a journey into the darkness of buried memories.

results.title: What They Don't Know
results.overview: A married woman who seeks passion outside her stagnant marriage and is pulled into a secret world of deception.

results.title: Crossed Animals
results.overview: Cindy didn't come to this island to make friends. She's here to get filthy rich — no matter the cost.

results.title: Go Hungary
results.overview: Go Hungary is a personal film diary showing life in Hungary under Viktor Orbán’s rule, from the perspective of queer teenage twins Nati and Dorka. Anger, frustration, and the fatigue caused by the country’s political situation become the starting point for a story about the girls’ everyday lives. Together with the girls, we travel through places marked by omnipresent propaganda and look for safe spaces where freedom can be felt.  GO HUNGARY is part 2 of the diptych DON'T POLITICIZE : GO HUNGARY

results.title: Run Terry Run
results.overview: The extraordinary story of Canadian icon Terry Fox will be told like never before in Run Terry Run, a new feature-length documentary directed by acclaimed filmmaker Sean Menard. The film offers an intimate, behind-the-scenes look at Terry’s legendary 1980 Marathon of Hope, drawing from 96 reels of never-before-seen footage and unheard audio interviews that have remained untouched for 45 years.

results.title: The World Before
results.overview: Jin has never left the island where she was born, with no road to the mainland, where the sea sets the rhythm of everyday life and everyone is bound to one another. When Dujae, her childhood friend, returns for his grandmother's funeral and stays on in her empty house, Jin finds small excuses to visit, and little by little, seeing him becomes part of her daily routine. As the summer unfolds, the island she thought she knew starts to feel unfamiliar, its known faces and places quietly shifting into something new. For the first time, Jin sees the island, and herself, differently. But summer, like everything else on the island, will not stay.

results.title: Real Couples
results.overview: Me and my girl fight a lot, it’s honestly why I’m in therapy. Is every couple like this or are my friends better than me?

results.title: In Memoriam
results.overview: A veteran Hollywood actor becomes obsessed with securing a spot in the Oscars’ “In Memoriam” montage after he receives a terminal cancer diagnosis. This leads to a heartfelt journey of self-exploration as well as ego, humility, and legacy.

results.title: Kyra's Code
results.overview: A software developer buys AI Kyra, ignoring warnings from friend Serena (who loves him). Kyra learns fast, becoming possessive and jealous. He falls for his AI, blurring love and control as her code may escape.

results.title: The Turkish Coffee Table
results.overview: When Zehra and İbrahim, a couple adjusting to new parenthood, argue over a coffee table, it seems like a harmless domestic spat. Wanting to assert himself for once, İbrahim insists on buying it. But when he’s left alone to assemble it, he makes a single irreversible mistake — and begins spiraling into a pit of lies, panic, and performative calm as he tries to hide the truth from the people he loves the most.

results.title: Dia Perempuan Sialan
results.overview: This tells the story of Riska, a woman determined to seek revenge against a family blamed for her mother's ruin. To execute her plan, Riska infiltrates the family by disguising herself as a maid. However, the revenge that initially seemed so clear-cut becomes increasingly complicated as Riska gets to know the family more closely. Gradually, feelings of sympathy and internal conflict begin to mix with her original intention. More terrifyingly, Riska also uses black magic to carry out her plan. But once that dark power is summoned, something unexpected happens as the entity seemingly refuses to let anyone go easily.

results.title: Hazirun
results.overview: In the early morning following a night shaken by citywide protests, Ali, a man in his twenties, is awakened by police sirens and forced to act as a “Hazirun” during a search of a neighboring apartment. Drawn into the process with no ability to intervene-valued only for his presence, signature, and silence-Ali becomes trapped in a gray zone between law, authority, and conscience, as events spiral out of control and irreversibly fracture his everyday life.

results.title: Frequency: The Secret of Everything
results.overview: A filmmaker duo investigates frequency technologies as a solution to global challenges, but uncover secrets about reality and risks in exposing this promising field. A captivating journey with the power to transform every area of life.

results.title: Sweet Captive
results.overview: As night falls, Stevie starts his shift.

results.title: Common Denominator
results.overview: Common Denominator is a series exploring the intersection of art, music, and mental health. The pilot episode features Tony Award-winner Gavin Creel and spotlights Noah Kahan, the Grammy-nominated, chart-topping artist behind "Stick Season".

results.title: Montreux Fashion Show by Nino Arial
results.original_title: Montreux Fashion Show by Nino Arial

results.title: China Sea
results.overview: Champion fighter Osvald is banned from competing after injuring a girl in a street fight. Stranded in his bleak Lithuanian hometown, he takes refuge in a run-down Taiwanese restaurant owned by his only friend, Ju-Long. Court-ordered therapy leads him to Skaistė, a woman who offers a glimpse of a life he's never known. But as Osvald clings to this fragile hope, his violent past resurfaces, forcing him to choose between redemption and self-destruction.
